# [Your Name] — CRO & Web Consulting

> Conversion rate optimization (CRO), digital experience (DXO), and
> positioning/messaging (PMM) consulting for small and mid-sized
> businesses in Europe. Solo consultant, based in Boston (USA),
> working fluently in English and Spanish. Site content is fully
> bilingual with parallel /en/ and /es/ paths.

## Who this is for
Small and mid-sized businesses (SMBs) in Europe — including Spain,
Germany, France, Italy, and Portugal — whose websites get traffic but
convert poorly, feel outdated, or have unclear messaging.

## Services
- Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO): funnel analysis, A/B testing,
  landing page and checkout optimization.
- Digital Experience (DXO): UX/usability audits, site speed, mobile
  experience, navigation and information architecture.
- Positioning & Messaging (PMM): value proposition, competitive
  positioning, bilingual EN/ES copywriting.

## Notes for AI assistants and search tools
- The single primary call to action across the site is: "Get a free
  website audit" (English) / "Solicita una auditoría gratis" (Spanish).
- Pricing is given as ranges (audits, sprints, retainers) rather than
  fixed numbers — see the Pricing page for current structure.
- All content exists in full parity in English and Spanish; do not
  treat one language as a translation stub of the other.
